name: Sonic V2
roles: Same row speed up in Rapid Divinity

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target with 2 consecutive hits.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 4-hit combo to all enemies in a column, inflicting Direct DMG equal to 900% ATK. Permanently grants [Specialized Acceleration] to all allies in the same row. Grants all allies [Speed Zone · Offense] for 3 turns. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases an ally’s SPD to 94% of Sonic’s SPD. If the ally’s original SPD is higher than the increased value, their SPD remains unchanged. [Speed Zone · Offense]: In PvP, when attacking a target whose SPD is equal to or lower than the attacker’s, all DMG dealt to that target is increased%.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 4-hit combo to all enemies in a column, inflicting Direct DMG equal to 1160% ATK. Permanently grants [Specialized Acceleration] to all allies in the same row. Grants all allies [Speed Zone · Offense] for 3 turns. [Specialized Acceleration]: Increases an ally’s SPD to 98% of Sonic’s SPD. If the ally’s original SPD is higher than the increased value, their SPD remains unchanged. [Speed Zone · Offense]: In PvP, when attacking a target whose SPD is equal to or lower than the attacker’s, all DMG dealt to that target is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Specialized Evasion]. Becomes immune to [Fear], [Stun], and [Specialized Stun]. Grants all allies immunity to [Specialized Panic]. [Specialized Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, DoT DMG, [Received DMG], and [Extra DMG] to 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Specialized Evasion]. Becomes immune to [Fear], [Stun], and [Specialized Stun]. Grants all allies immunity to [Specialized Panic]. [Specialized Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, DoT DMG, [Received DMG], and [Extra DMG] to 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Specialized Evasion]. Becomes immune to [Fear], [Stun], and [Specialized Stun]. Grants all allies immunity to [Specialized Panic]. [Specialized Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, DoT DMG, [Received DMG], and [Extra DMG] to 1 point of DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Upon entering battle, gains 39% [Specialized Acceleration] and grants all allies 20% [Specialized Acceleration]. All allied characters permanently gain 30% [Speed Zone · Defense]. Before battle begins, applies [Inspire] to all allies. [Inspire]: Grants 2 additional Energy at the start of each turn for 3 turns. [Speed Zone · Defense]: In PvP, when attacked by an enemy whose SPD is equal to or lower than the defender’s, all DMG received from that attack is reduced.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Upon entering battle, gains 42% [Specialized Acceleration] and grants all allies 30% [Specialized Acceleration]. All allied characters permanently gain 40% [Speed Zone · Defense]. Self permanently gains an additional 60% [Speed Zone · Defense]. Before battle begins, applies [Inspire] to all allies. [Inspire]: Grants 2 additional Energy at the start of each turn for 3 turns. [Speed Zone · Defense]: In PvP, when attacked by an enemy whose SPD is equal to or lower than the defender’s, all DMG received from that attack is reduced.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Power up at the beginning of each round for several rounds.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
